#!/bin/bash
# Ansible Control Node Setup Script
# This script installs Ansible and related tools on Ubuntu

set -e

echo "==> Starting Ansible Control Node Setup"

# Function to wait for apt locks to be released
wait_for_apt() {
    local max_wait=300
    local waited=0
    while sudo fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
          sudo fuser /var/lib/apt/lists/lock >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
          sudo fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock >/dev/null 2>&1; do
        if [ $waited -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "==> Waiting for apt locks to be released..."
        fi
        sleep 5
        waited=$((waited + 5))
        if [ $waited -ge $max_wait ]; then
            echo "==> Timeout waiting for apt locks after ${max_wait}s"
            exit 1
        fi
    done
    if [ $waited -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "==> Apt locks released after ${waited}s"
    fi
}

# Disable unattended-upgrades to prevent lock conflicts
echo "==> Stopping unattended-upgrades..."
sudo systemctl stop unattended-upgrades 2>/dev/null || true
sudo systemctl disable unattended-upgrades 2>/dev/null || true

# Wait for any existing apt processes to finish
wait_for_apt

# Update package list
echo "==> Updating package list..."
sudo apt-get update

# Install Python and pip
echo "==> Installing Python and dependencies..."
sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip python3-venv pipx git sshpass libssh-dev libldap2-dev libsasl2-dev

# Install Ansible via pipx with global flag (system-wide)
echo "==> Installing Ansible system-wide via pipx..."
sudo PIPX_HOME=/opt/pipx PIPX_BIN_DIR=/usr/local/bin pipx install ansible-core --include-deps

# Install ansible-lint system-wide
echo "==> Installing ansible-lint..."
sudo PIPX_HOME=/opt/pipx PIPX_BIN_DIR=/usr/local/bin pipx install ansible-lint

# Inject additional dependencies into ansible environment
echo "==> Installing additional Python packages..."
sudo PIPX_HOME=/opt/pipx PIPX_BIN_DIR=/usr/local/bin pipx inject ansible-core jmespath netaddr ansible-pylibssh python-ldap pymongo pymysql psycopg2-binary boto3 botocore kubernetes

# Install common Ansible collections (for all users)
echo "==> Installing Ansible collections..."
sudo mkdir -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install community.general -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install ansible.posix -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install community.docker -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install community.crypto -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install ansible.netcommon -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install community.mysql -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install community.postgresql -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install community.mongodb -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install ansible.utils -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install community.rabbitmq -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install amazon.aws -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install community.aws -p /usr/share/ansible/collections
sudo ansible-galaxy collection install kubernetes.core -p /usr/share/ansible/collections

# Workspace files are copied by the image builder into /root.
echo "==> Setting up ansible.cfg for root workspace..."
mv /root/ansible.cfg /root/.ansible.cfg
chown root:root /root/.ansible.cfg

# run.sh is the workspace entry script.
chmod +x /root/run.sh
chown root:root /root/run.sh

# Note: SSH key is now baked into image via img_content/root/.ssh/

# Verify installation
echo ""
echo "==> Installation Complete!"
echo "==> Ansible version:"
ansible --version

echo ""
echo "==> ansible-lint version:"
ansible-lint --version

echo ""
echo "==> Installed collections:"
ansible-galaxy collection list

echo ""
echo "==> SSH key status:"
if [ -f ~/.ssh/id_rsa ]; then
    echo "    ~/.ssh/id_rsa - INSTALLED (via img_content)"
    ls -la ~/.ssh/
else
    echo "    ~/.ssh/id_rsa - NOT FOUND (ansible connections will fail)"
fi

echo ""
echo "==> Scripts baked into image:"
echo "    ~/run.sh - runs ansible-playbook"
echo ""
echo "==> Ansible Control Node is ready!"
---
#!/bin/bash
# Run Ansible playbook
set -e

export HOME=/root USER=root LOGNAME=root
cd /root

echo "==> EXECUTED_FILE: ${EXECUTED_FILE:-'(not set)'}"

# Check required files exist
if [ ! -f /root/inventory.ini ]; then
  echo "==> ERROR: /root/inventory.ini not found. LLM must generate this file."
  exit 1
fi

echo "==> Using inventory:"
cat /root/inventory.ini

# Use EXECUTED_FILE env var
PLAYBOOK="${EXECUTED_FILE}"

if [ -z "$PLAYBOOK" ]; then
  echo "==> ERROR: No playbook specified. Set EXECUTED_FILE env var."
  exit 1
fi

echo "==> Running Ansible playbook: $PLAYBOOK"
ANSIBLE_HOST_KEY_CHECKING=False ansible-playbook -i /root/inventory.ini "$PLAYBOOK"

        self.cli_delete(base_path)
